text_block_list.text:
One day, Grass Wonder invited me to attend 
a Japanese classical dance trial workshop 
along with other students—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Traditional dance really brings 
calm to the heart, doesn't it~? How did 
everyone else find it?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It's fun, but it's so hard~! I can't do it 
like Grass-senpai at all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"A professional. She came here to 
learn――... Unlike us."

Grass Wonder's dance was undeniably a cut 
above the other participants, refined and 
exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I still have a long way to go as well~. I 
certainly pale in comparison to the 'real 
deal.'"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The dance of a true master is an 
entirely different world, rich with the 
weight of history.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"The amount of time spent to reach that 
point... is a realm beyond my 
imagination."

text_block_list.name: Japanese Dance Master
text_block_list.text:
—You displayed considerable skill as well. 
That dance from earlier would easily pass 
muster on a grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Master... you flatter me. It is all 
thanks to your kind guidance of this 
humble junior.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Dance Master
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, we have an opening in the 
upcoming performance. Would you be willing 
to fill in as an understudy?"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing, Grass-senpai! A true 
collaboration between human and Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No way... Could my dance truly measure up? 
To the craft of our predecessors, to 
history itself—

text_block_list.name: Inner Voice
text_block_list.text:
"You must never forget the weight of that 
responsibility. Especially when you are 
still young and inexperienced."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, they expect that I'm the one 
who can stand shoulder-to-shoulder with 
her."

text_block_list.name: Inner Voice
text_block_list.text:
"So you're saying that taking on a 
challenge without knowing one's place is 
disrespectful?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...No, that is not the case.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Facing it head-on with everything I have, 
without turning away. That is the greatest 
form of respect I can show.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Bearing my ambitions high, I reach for 
greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Are you all right? Don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I hesitated for a moment. However, 
please do not worry."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I humbly accept the role as a stand-in for 
the traditional Japanese dance.

After waiting backstage for a while, Grass 
Wonder appeared, having finished her 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Proof of my resolve. I have cloaked 
myself in the determination to reach 
greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Traditional Japanese dance is a world of 
pure skill where excuses have no place. 
That is precisely why I intend to 
challenge it with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I shall step forth to do what must be 
done!

I can feel Grass Wonder's strong 
determination. As her Trainer, I have to 
give her all the support I can—
choice_data_list: Let's dance! Just follow your heart!

There is no need to feel intimidated. You 
can do it.

There is no need to feel intimidated. I 
know you can do it.

text_block_list.text:
I can feel Grass Wonder's strong 
determination. As her Trainer, I have to 
give her all the support I can—
choice_data_list: Let's dance! Just follow your heart!

There is no need to feel intimidated. You 
can do it.

There is no need to feel intimidated. I 
know you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's starting! Grass-senpai's looking 
fired up!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...There is a gap in skill. But... what 
is this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"How wild... So ferocious. And yet... it 
speaks directly to the soul."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's amazing...! It makes me feel 
like giving it my all, too...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(Please, feast your eyes to your heart's 
content. On everything I have to give!)

Grass Wonder danced with majestic poise, 
overwhelming the audience not with 
technique, but with sheer heart...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I will make sure this 
challenge bears fruit!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(I am surprisingly calm, even to myself. 
Despite having no proven technique to back 
it up.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
(...Even so! If there is even a chance 
that my dance might help!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Grass-senpai and the teacher are in 
perfect sync! Way to go!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Wonderful... What a beautiful culture.

The audience watches Grass Wonder's 
majestic dance with rapt attention. It 
seems they are completely captivated by 
her resolve.
